# Schilly's Take Out & Catering Kitchen

> Smoked BBQ, homemade comfort food and family-size meals for take out in Casco, Maine (Lakes Region, Route 302), plus catering for weddings, backyard BBQs, corporate events, private parties, lobster bakes and pig roasts.

- Address: 224 Roosevelt Trail, Casco, ME 04015
- Phone: (207) 693-8840
- Hours: Wednesday–Sunday, 11am–6pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/schillyseats
- Take out: BBQ plates $28–$35 (pulled chicken, pulled pork, sliced brisket, three meat; with mac & cheese, BBQ beans, coleslaw, cornbread), white cheddar mac & cheese bowls, family-size portions (4 servings), BBQ sandwiches, specialty beef hot dogs, sides, desserts. Prices include Maine sales tax.
- Catering: boxed lunches, elevated boxed lunches, boxed salads, soups and chowders, party platters/boards/grazes (serve 10–12), dips, desserts. Priced per event.
- Dietary: homemade black bean burger is gluten-free and vegan; gluten-free Udi's bun available.
